title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, and Geoffrey E. Hinton published a NeurIPS 2012 paper describing a large deep convolutional neural network for ImageNet classification. The paper reports a network with five convolutional and three fully connected layers, trained with a GPU implementation, and reports a winning ILSVRC-2012 top-5 test error rate of 15.3% for a model variant.
significance: A documented 2012 deep-learning and computer-vision milestone demonstrating large-scale convolutional neural network performance on ImageNet and the ILSVRC-2012 competition.
